The quotation discusses: integrating services at the local level, pooling budgets based on local priorities, and giving communities resources to participate in decisions affecting them. The core mechanism is **decentralized/local collective decision-making and budget allocation authority**.

This is about how decisions are made collectively at the local level — shifting decision-making power from central to local communities. This fits within D7 (Analysis of Collective Decision-Making).

Looking at D7 codes:

- D71 — Social Choice • Clubs • Committees • Associations

The quotation is specifically about administrative processes in public organizations (pooling budgets, integrating services) and community participation in decisions — this maps to **D73** (Bureaucracy • Administrative Processes in Public Organizations) combined with the policy formulation angle. However, D78 covers "Positive Analysis of Policy Formulation and Implementation" which fits the policy design aspect.

The most precise match: the quotation is about restructuring administrative/bureaucratic processes in public organizations (service integration, budget pooling) at the local level — **D73**.
